title: Configure a KV lookup and restore service
instructions: An application cannot read its asset lookup. Inspect server.conf with splunk btool server list kvstore --debug on sh01. Compare disk and running state. Correct the kvstore setting in the KV Store configuration page or terminal and restart Splunk. Verify | inputlookup assets_lookup returns both baseline assets. Close the incident with a root-cause and verification explanation. Collection and transforms changes use app reload; server changes require restart.
completionScope: KV checks validate persisted collection contents, service health and recovery outcomes. Review your explanation separately.
